window.start: Immediately before measured PAGE B Product navigation
window.requestAdmission: Only this page and its child frames while window is open; frozen at cutoff
window.metrics: LCP, CLS, established long-task TBT proxy snapshot at cutoff; drain does not extend observation

cache.context: Fresh independent BrowserContext for each measured sample; only memory authentication cookies copied
cache.cold: HTTP cache cleared before first Product navigation; no Product prime; bypass service workers
cache.warm: PAGE A same-route prime under approved throttle, load/fonts/1500ms, separate recorder drain, close A; PAGE B new target in SAME BrowserContext, cache retained, same throttle, first B navigation measured
cache.primeTraffic: PRIMING_LIFECYCLE target provenance, including close/unload diagnostics; never excluded by URL
cache.measuredTelemetry: Counts normally if initiated by PAGE B within measurement window

provenance.scope: Page-specific CDP session and Playwright Page events, including child frames
provenance.correlation: Unique same-target wall time within 2ms, method and URL; Playwright request object for all-frame lifecycle; ambiguity invalidates

decision.failure: One mandatory valid triplet failure suffices; remaining 90 not needed to prove failure
decision.success: Canary pass is not certification; 90 additional valid samples still required
